solid.box: length, width, height: expr; corner?: [x,y,z] | center?: [x,y,z] (numbers in mm or length expressions; default: the origin); operation?, targets?: [body], name?, body_name?
solid.cylinder: radius | diameter, height: expr; base?: [x,y,z] (centre of the bottom: numbers in mm or length expressions; default: the origin); axis?: X|Y|Z|[x,y,z] (default Z); references?: [{edge: [x,y,z] on a straight edge of the face it stands on, distance: expr}] (at most two, as solid.hole's: the base centre goes that far from each edge's line, in the face's plane, and follows the edges; with a numeric base only); operation?, targets?: [body], name?, body_name?
solid.fillet: edges: [[x,y,z] point on edge | {body, index}]; radius: expr; body?; type?: constant|curvature (alias g2: curvature-continuous quintic between planar faces along straight edges, one planar end face at each end (including sloped ends); radius sets the equivalent circular setback, not constant curvature; exact fit only)|chord (radius is the width across)|variable (radius at the end nearest start, radius2 at the other; one end may be 0, where the round closes to the corner)|spline (the radius along the edge is a clamped B-spline from the end nearest start: radius is its first control radius, radii the rest, knots its knot vector from 0 to 1; one end may be 0); radius2?; start?: [x,y,z]; radii?: [expr, …]; knots?: [number, …]; mid?: [[position 0…1 from start, radius expr], …] (variable radii between the ends); smooth?: bool (smooth instead of straight between the radii); corner?: rolling|g2 (rolling, the default: the corners where three blended edges meet are pieces of the rolling ball's sphere, tangent to each blend; g2: a patch repeating each blend's surface up to the second order, constant-radius exact fillets only, refused where it cannot be built); fit?: exact|reduce|taper (exact, the default: a radius too large for the geometry around the edges is refused; reduce: where it doesn't fit it is reduced to the largest that does, one radius for edges sharing a face; the smallest used is returned as `radius_applied`, each edge's as `radii_applied: [{edge: [x,y,z], radius}]`, and noted in the feature's warning; taper: along each straight edge between planar faces where it doesn't fit, the radius follows the room there as a smooth spline, down to 0 where a face closes to a point, noted in the feature's warning)
solid.move: bodies: [names]; translate?: [x,y,z] (exprs or numbers); axis?: [x,y,z]; angle?: expr; copy?: bool (default false: keeps the original bodies and transforms a new copy instead of moving them in place)
file.save_mesh: path; format?: stl|3mf|3mf-tagged (default from the extension, else stl; 3mf-tagged: docs/formats/3mf-face-tags.md); bodies?: [names] (default: all); ascii?: bool (STL); slicer?: id or name from file.slicers, the program path it lists, or a program the user added under Custom… (send the saved file there, through the same steps as file.send_to_slicer: a slicer that has to be started first is waited for; may be deprecated later in favour of file.send_to_slicer or a Send to App workflow, kept for scripts); single_instance?: bool (default true; see file.send_to_slicer); quality?: standard|fine|finest (STL, OBJ and 3MF: how closely the mesh follows curved faces, a chord tolerance of 2e-4, 5e-5 or 1e-5 of each body's size; default standard)
inspect.measure: bodies?: [names] (default all) → closed per body; volume_mm3, center_of_mass, density_g_cm3 and mass_g only for closed, consistently oriented bodies; area, bbox and counts for all; total.open_bodies_skipped counts bodies excluded from volume/mass totals; or items: [1-2 selections] (face/edge: type, body, point; index optional) → length/area/volume; diameter, radius, circumference or arc_length/angle_deg of circles, arcs and cylinders; slot sizes; min (distance_mm, from, to), max, center_distance (centre to centre, or from an axis) and angle
